taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-03, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given vertical electrical sounding (VES), we first identify the resistivity of each layer:

- Layer 1 ($r_1$): 177.8 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 2 ($r_2$): 265.8 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 3 ($r_3$): 1064.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 4 ($r_4$): 2584.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

Next, we evaluate the groups of three consecutive layers according to the provided rules:
1.  **Layers 1-2-3**: We compare $r_1$, $r_2$, and $r_3$. 
    $177.8 < 265.8 < 1064.5$. 
    This fits the condition $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4**: We compare $r_2$, $r_3$, and $r_4$.
    $265.8 < 1064.5 < 2584.7$.
    This fits the condition $r_2 < r_3 < r_4$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.

The resulting sequence of letters is **AA**. According to the rule that if all letters are the same, the curve may be written as a single letter, the curve type is **A**.

{"curve_type": "A"}
